plan.scope: Browser-only numerical precision experiments; physical force laws, CAD, policy and independent walking acceptance unchanged. Not a relaxation of physical task gates.
notes: Compare all 50 Hz sampled states against the original 1e-8 tolerance run.
Foot impulses use trapezoidal integration of sampled floor forces; this is not a resolved impact impulse guarantee.
Retain contact identity/mode changes for diagnosis and independent stepping/geometry/stop checks.
A selected candidate also requires refined-timestep, reserved disturbance, native/WASM and rendered timing checks.

Added 1e-5 after completed 1e-7/1e-6 native profiles showed 11%/21% fewer Newton iterations but only modest total-work reduction. Same declared trajectory limits apply. Earlier pre-reuse controller trials tested this tolerance without meeting browser timing.

Joint coordinates include rotational and prismatic units: the 0.0001 numerical bound is applied separately as radians or metres using runtime-exported coordinate metadata. Contact-mode identity and gait-phase identity must also match exactly.

Added independent-block factorization at the original 1e-8 precision after inspecting the existing unpromoted library option. Same numerical screens and original closure/rank checks apply. This candidate is not a physical equation reduction.
Precision-only rendered minute completed at realtime but p95 22.86 ms still missed 20 ms; compare block factorization alone and combined with 1e-5 at the same screens. No precision-only promotion.

Combined block/1e-5 rendered minute misses p95 at 20.32 ms. Next candidate halves cached first-attempt cap to 12, retaining fresh-restart limit 80, and enables existing guarded backtracking. Same numerical and physical screens apply.

First guarded refined-minute recipe was rejected at step 0: its inherited reference profile did not enable fresh restarts while a cached-attempt cap was set. Preserve that invalid recipe and result; corrected recipe explicitly enables the same fresh-restart policy as the browser. No physical state advanced on the invalid trial.

walking.scope: Initial flat-floor commissioning with ideal observations. Actual clearance/support samples, endpoint tracking and stop checked; not between-sample impact accuracy, terrain robustness, hardware calibration or sustained realtime acceptance.

numerical_screen.scope: Whole 50 Hz sampled trajectory differences against the retained 1e-8 solve, with runtime-declared rotational and translational units. Integrated force discrepancy is trapezoidal integration of force-difference magnitude, so cancellation cannot hide disagreement. Not resolved impact accuracy, hardware calibration or independent walking acceptance.
